interface.signature: def stringConversion(X: str, Y: str) -> int:

preconditions.description: X and Y must be strings.
Lengths of X and Y must be between 1 and 1000 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if all(Y[i] == X[j].upper() for i in range(len(Y)) for j in range(len(X)) if Y[i] == X[j].upper() or Y[i] == X[j].lower()) and len(Y) <= len(X) else 0
postconditions.description: Return 1 if Y can be obtained by converting some lowercase letters in X to uppercase and deleting all remaining lowercase letters; otherwise return 0.
